dream.title: you were here last night
dream.text: i dreamt you were here last night, holding me so tight i couldn’t move, your hand in my hair. i didn’t want to wake up.

song.note: 1:04.52 measured off the label's own stream — Sophie's 1:04 by ear was right. The line is "You was in my dream last night" (singular, and "was"), so it is not quite the domain.

beats.text: now it doesn’t have to be a secret
